## `engineering_material_requests` — 工程用料审批

| 项目 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| Schema | <code>public</code> |
| 分类 | Source Document / 源单据 |
| 用途 | 保存订单用料汇总的提交、老板审核、财务核价、退回和不可改写的来源快照。 |
| 明确不负责 | 不作为库存和付款事实。已确认样品与启用 BOM 才能提交；来源变动阻断审批；同单最多一份未退回审批。 |
| 生命周期 / 删除语义 | SUBMITTED 到 BOSS_APPROVED 到 APPROVED；前两态可有原因退回 REJECTED，重新提交生成新记录。 |
| 写入边界 | SalesOrderUsecase 的用料提交与审批事务写入；财务批准和采购单生成同一事务。 |
| Catalog 敏感字段 | <code>source_snapshot</code> |

### CHECK 约束

- <code>engineering_material_requests_boss_evidence</code>

```sql
status NOT IN ('BOSS_APPROVED', 'APPROVED') OR (boss_reviewed_by IS NOT NULL AND boss_reviewed_at IS NOT NULL)
```

- <code>engineering_material_requests_finance_evidence</code>

```sql
status <> 'APPROVED' OR (finance_reviewed_by IS NOT NULL AND finance_reviewed_at IS NOT NULL)
```

- <code>engineering_material_requests_rejection_evidence</code>

```sql
status <> 'REJECTED' OR (rejected_by IS NOT NULL AND rejected_at IS NOT NULL AND review_note IS NOT NULL)
```

- <code>engineering_material_requests_status_allowed</code>

```sql
status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'BOSS_APPROVED', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED')
```

## `purchase_orders` — 采购订单

| 项目 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| Schema | <code>public</code> |
| 分类 | Source Document / 源单据 |
| 用途 | 保存向供应商采购物料的业务承诺、日期、交付和结算条件。 |
| 明确不负责 | 采购订单不是 BOM、入库、库存、质检或应付事实。 工程用料经老板、财务两人依次批准后，按厂商生成 approved 采购单，并以来源审批和厂商唯一约束防止重复。 |
| 生命周期 / 删除语义 | draft 转 submitted、approved，再 closed；允许按状态 canceled；不物理删除。 |
| 写入边界 | PurchaseOrderUsecase 创建、草稿聚合保存、提交、审批、关闭和取消。 |

### CHECK 约束

- <code>purchase_orders_currency_allowed</code>

```sql
currency IN ('USD', 'CNY', 'HKD')
```

- <code>purchase_orders_invoice_category_allowed</code>

```sql
invoice_category IS NULL OR invoice_category IN ('EXPORT_GENERAL', 'VAT_GENERAL_1', 'VAT_SPECIAL_3', 'VAT_SPECIAL_13')
```

- <code>purchase_orders_invoice_pair_valid</code>

```sql
((invoice_required IS NULL AND invoice_category IS NULL) OR (invoice_required = false AND invoice_category IS NULL) OR (invoice_required = true AND invoice_category IS NOT NULL))
```

- <code>purchase_orders_lifecycle_status_allowed</code>

```sql
lifecycle_status IN ('draft', 'submitted', 'approved', 'closed', 'canceled')
```

- <code>purchase_orders_payment_term_days_nonnegative</code>

```sql
payment_term_days IS NULL OR payment_term_days >= 0
```

- <code>purchase_orders_version_positive</code>

```sql
version > 0
```

## `sales_order_items` — 销售订单明细

| 项目 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| Schema | <code>public</code> |
| 分类 | Source Document / 源单据 |
| 用途 | 保存客户需求、客户款号、新单或返单、订单数量、船头样和工程产品关联；产品可在接单后补建。 |
| 明确不负责 | 工程样品状态与订单生效分开。样品确认绑定 BOM 内容指纹、产品图片和确认人；返单只能沿用同客户已确认的同款资料。实际出货量只由出货事实派生。 |
| 生命周期 / 删除语义 | 草稿聚合内可维护；行状态 open、closed 或 canceled；正式行不独立物理删除。 |
| 写入边界 | SalesOrderUsecase 分别控制商务草稿和工程资料事务；用料提交后不允许改写对应工程来源。 |
| Catalog 敏感字段 | <code>import_source</code> |

### CHECK 约束

- <code>sales_order_items_amount_non_negative</code>

```sql
amount IS NULL OR amount >= 0
```

- <code>sales_order_items_category_allowed</code>

```sql
order_category IN ('NEW', 'REPEAT')
```

- <code>sales_order_items_display_order_positive</code>

```sql
display_order IS NULL OR display_order > 0
```

- <code>sales_order_items_engineering_status_allowed</code>

```sql
engineering_status IN ('PREPARING', 'SAMPLING', 'CONFIRMED')
```

- <code>sales_order_items_line_no_positive</code>

```sql
line_no > 0
```

- <code>sales_order_items_line_status_allowed</code>

```sql
line_status IN ('open', 'closed', 'canceled')
```

- <code>sales_order_items_ordered_qty_positive</code>

```sql
ordered_quantity > 0
```

- <code>sales_order_items_sample_quantity_nonnegative</code>

```sql
pre_shipment_sample_quantity >= 0
```

- <code>sales_order_items_sampling_requires_sources</code>

```sql
engineering_status = 'PREPARING' OR (product_id IS NOT NULL AND sample_bom_id IS NOT NULL)
```

- <code>sales_order_items_sku_requires_product</code>

```sql
product_sku_id IS NULL OR product_id IS NOT NULL
```

- <code>sales_order_items_unit_price_non_negative</code>

```sql
unit_price IS NULL OR unit_price >= 0
```

## `sales_orders` — 销售订单

| 项目 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| Schema | <code>public</code> |
| 分类 | Source Document / 源单据 |
| 用途 | 保存客户订单承诺、交付计划、付款方式和销售责任信息。 |
| 明确不负责 | 销售订单生效不等于已预留、已生产、已出货或已产生应收。 |
| 生命周期 / 删除语义 | draft 转 submitted、active，再 closed；允许按状态 canceled；不物理删除。 |
| 写入边界 | SalesOrderUsecase 创建、草稿聚合保存、提交、生效、关闭和取消。 |

### CHECK 约束

- <code>sales_orders_currency_allowed</code>

```sql
currency IN ('USD', 'CNY', 'HKD')
```

- <code>sales_orders_freight_terms_allowed</code>

```sql
freight_terms IS NULL OR freight_terms IN ('INCLUDED', 'EXCLUDED')
```

- <code>sales_orders_goods_amount_nonnegative</code>

```sql
goods_amount IS NULL OR goods_amount >= 0
```

- <code>sales_orders_lifecycle_status_allowed</code>

```sql
lifecycle_status IN ('draft', 'submitted', 'active', 'closed', 'canceled')
```

- <code>sales_orders_order_total_nonnegative</code>

```sql
order_total IS NULL OR order_total >= 0
```

- <code>sales_orders_quoted_freight_nonnegative</code>

```sql
quoted_freight_amount IS NULL OR quoted_freight_amount >= 0
```

- <code>sales_orders_quoted_freight_terms_valid</code>

```sql
quoted_freight_amount IS NULL OR freight_terms = 'EXCLUDED'
```

- <code>sales_orders_tax_amount_nonnegative</code>

```sql
tax_amount IS NULL OR tax_amount >= 0
```

- <code>sales_orders_tax_mode_allowed</code>

```sql
tax_mode IS NULL OR tax_mode IN ('INCLUSIVE', 'EXCLUSIVE', 'NONE')
```

- <code>sales_orders_tax_pair_valid</code>

```sql
((tax_mode IS NULL AND tax_rate IS NULL) OR (tax_mode = 'NONE' AND tax_rate IS NULL) OR (tax_mode IN ('INCLUSIVE', 'EXCLUSIVE') AND tax_rate IS NOT NULL))
```

- <code>sales_orders_tax_rate_valid</code>

```sql
tax_rate IS NULL OR (tax_rate > 0 AND tax_rate <= 100)
```

- <code>sales_orders_version_positive</code>

```sql
version > 0
```

<a id="table-source-order-lifecycle-events"></a>

## `source_order_lifecycle_events` — 来源订单生命周期回执

| 项目 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| Schema | <code>public</code> |
| 分类 | Source Document / 源单据 |
| 用途 | 追加保存销售、采购和委外订单强动作的版本、幂等意图及逐行结算结果。 |
| 明确不负责 | 回执证明某次关闭或取消及逐行剩余量，不替代来源订单当前状态，也不构成履约 Fact。 |
| 生命周期 / 删除语义 | 按来源类型、来源 ID 和幂等键只追加；同一意图精确重放，变更意图冲突，不更新、不删除。 |
| 写入边界 | 各来源订单 repo 在锁定源单、终结 open 行并更新单头的同一事务中写入。 |

| 字段 | PostgreSQL 类型 | Ent 类型 | NULL | 数据库默认值 | 结构属性 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| <code>source_type</code> | <code>varchar(32)</code> | <code>string</code> | 非空 | — | — | 业务含义以字段名、表用途、约束和链接的 schema/usecase 为准。 |

| <code>source_version</code> | <code>bigint</code> | <code>int</code> | 非空 | — | — | 业务含义以字段名、表用途、约束和链接的 schema/usecase 为准。 |
| <code>action_key</code> | <code>varchar(32)</code> | <code>string</code> | 非空 | — | — | 业务含义以字段名、表用途、约束和链接的 schema/usecase 为准。 |

- <code>source_order_lifecycle_events_contract_v1</code>

```

```
